description: Use this when someone wants slides about a topic across companies' decks, for example a project, a market, a peer comparison or a named asset, or what one company's own decks say about one of its projects or deposits (how it was discovered, its history): then give the company too. Give it the words to find ("discovery" also finds "discovered", "history" also "historic"). Returns matching slides from every deck in 6ix's Deck library, or from all of that company's decks, its oldest too, newest decks first (a deck's matching slides together), with company, deck, date, slide number, a short excerpt and 6ix.com link, and how many decks match (decks, not slides); pass nextCursor as cursor for more slides.

company.description: Only this company's own decks. Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

query.description: Words to find on slides; with company, leave the company's name out

name: search_decks

decksFound.description: Decks that match the words (decks, not slides), counted when the search began

decksShown.description: Different decks among this answer's slides

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

whatChanged.description: What changed from the company's previous version of this deck

title: Search deck slides
